what: Behind the board, four elliptical orbits drawn with white tubes (two solid, two translucent dashed, tube radius .01) hang at different tilts and turn very slowly (per frame y += .002(i+1)×.1, x += .001(i+1)×.1), and in each orbit one blue dot travels along it by (.3 + i×.15)×.01×.2 per step — perspective camera z 7 · FOV 40, fog (1~40) erases the far side with the background color. The same seed always gives the same layout (three)

options.dashed: Number of dotted orbits (translucent .5, dash·gap .045), default 2

note: To use as a fixed background, set the element to position:fixed; Laid out with inset:0. Colors are --kf-surface (tube)·--kf-accent (dot)·--kf-bg (fog)

from.where: All pages .bg-orbits — screen-fixed background (on the first page it turns on at 2s during the 3s entrance)
